name: godweave
lore_descriptor: thread of starlight, almost weightless, almost not there
first_pickup_chronicle: Godweave. The metal that isn't metal — a thread of starlight pulled from the heaven-fabric and woven into a blade. Holds enchantment beyond the limits of any earthly forge.
design_notes: Band F light-enchantable magical_metal. Mult 1.30, weight 0.6 (lightest in game), max_enchant 8 (highest in game). Cannot be cursed. The endgame enchanter's dream — base damage modest, but a +8 godweave weapon is the meta-best.
